# Summary of Work So Far

## Completed
- Read all source files (`src/humanize/__init__.py`, `src/humanize/time.py`, `src/humanize/number.py`, `src/humanize/filesize.py`, `src/humanize/i18n.py`)
- Read all test files (`tests/test_time.py`, `tests/test_number.py`, `tests/test_filesize.py`, `tests/test_i18n.py`, `tests/test_humanize.py`)
- Existing tests pass (388 passed, 15 skipped)

## Pending Changes Needed

### R3 - Overflow in naturaldelta/naturaltime
- **Location**: `src/humanize/time.py` lines 204-205
- **Issue**: Uses `abs(delta.seconds)` and `abs(delta.days)` which can overflow for extremely large timedeltas
- **Fix**: Replace with `delta.total_seconds()` approach to avoid integer overflow

### R4 - Type hints for all public functions
- **Functions needing hints**: `Unit`, `activate`, `apnumber`, `clamp`, `deactivate`, `fractional`, `get_translation`, `intcomma`, `intword`, `naturaldate`, `naturalday`, `naturaldelta`, `naturalsize`, `naturaltime`, `ordinal`, `precisedelta`, `scientific`
- **Status**: Many functions lack return type annotations or have incomplete parameter types
- **Files affected**: `src/humanize/time.py`, `src/humanize/number.py`, `src/humanize/i18n.py`, `src/humanize/filesize.py`, `src/humanize/__init__.py`

### R5 - New `metric` function
- **Requirement**: Create new public function `metric()` that converts numeric values to metric prefix representation (kilo, mega, etc.) while preserving significant figures
- **Needs**: Add to `src/humanize/number.py` (or new module), export in `src/humanize/__init__.py`
- **Status**: Not yet implemented

### R6 - intcomma ndigits=0 bug
- **Location**: `src/humanize/number.py` line 127
- **Issue**: `if ndigits:` evaluates to False when `ndigits=0`, skipping decimal formatting
- **Fix**: Change to `if ndigits is not None:` to properly handle the zero case

## Next Steps
1. Fix R6 (simplest fix - one line change)
2. Fix R3 (overflow handling in time.py)
3. Implement R5 (new metric function)
4. Add R4 type hints to all public functions
5. Run tests to verify all changes work correctly
